1.why: 'dilemma' is the only abstract predicament among three ordinary concrete happenings, but the axis is weak enough that this is a coin flip.

2.why: Only positive-valence option among three negative reception words (unread, misquoted, contested), so the key stands apart by valence.

3.why: 'uncomfortable' names a felt state while calculated/sincere/habitual all name a manner of acting, but the split is not clean.

4.why: 'exact' is about precision while the other three are about attitude or frequency; no strong structural tell.

5.why: Two-two split (disputed/unpublished = status, understated/rounded = alteration of a figure); nothing isolates one option.

6.why: 'lengthy' describes duration while impatient/hesitant/mechanical all describe a person's manner - the key is the odd one by category.

7.why: 'rival' is the only adversarial rather than institutional role, but sponsor/witness/judge do not cluster tightly enough to be sure.

8.why: Four unrelated axes (cost, age, formality, simplicity) with no cluster and no odd one out - genuinely clean.

9.why: 'escort' is the only concrete physical action; praise/provoke/imitate are all responses to another person's behaviour.

10.why: All four share the adverb+participle frame; 'poorly timed' is the only evaluative one, which is a thin basis.

11.why: 'guarded' is the only withholding trait among three outward-facing, socially open ones.

12.why: 'hard to find' is about availability while the other three are temperament descriptions in the same frame.

13.why: 'luck' is chance, while location/quality/timing are all controllable attributes of a thing or event.

14.why: 'idle' is about inactivity rather than manner toward others, but all four are ordinary character flaws of similar register.

15.why: Two-two split (postpone/hasten = timing, record/approve = handling); no option is isolated.

16.why: Split between states (anxious, weary) and behaviours (rude, evasive), so no single odd one out.

17.why: 'trimmed' is the only deliberate human action; tangled/faded/soaked are conditions that happen to a thing.

18.why: Four traits on four different axes (social, physical, emotional, mental) with no cluster - clean set.

19.why: 'skillful' names an ability while patient/humble/willing are all dispositions, so the key sits at a different level of description.

20.why: 'scrimmages' is the only concrete countable plural; fundamentals/strategy/conditioning are abstract training nouns.

21.why: 'doubt' is a mental attitude while recall/perform/explain are all things done with material.

22.why: The other three are clean antonym pairs on one axis; 'hurried . . . polished' pairs two different axes, so it is the odd construction.

23.why: 'solitude' is the only condition that need not be a hardship, but confusion/exhaustion/poverty do not form a single cluster.

24.why: Harm, cost, extent and duration are four independent axes; nothing distinguishes one option structurally.

25.why: 'profitable' is the only positive outcome among three adverse ones (confusing, costly, permanent).

26.why: 'repotted' is the only deliberate human action; wilted/scorched/overgrown are conditions a plant falls into.

27.why: Two-two split (coincidence/misunderstanding accidental, precaution/routine intentional); no isolated option.

28.why: 'fragile' implies vulnerability while deep/recent/local are dimension, time and place, but each option already sits on its own axis.

29.why: 'illegible' is about physical legibility while provisional/outdated/unofficial all describe a document's authority status.

30.why: 'short . . . extend' is the only pair where the verb directly remedies the adjective; the other three pairings are semantically unrelated halves.
